cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before calling it our discovery, mention who found the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yes. After my receipt introduced it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your name in the report.

mechanism: A turns its pupil report-writing into a citation lesson to secure credit for finding the decisive proof, distinguishing discovery from attendance.
confusable: Not merely wanting praise for mentoring: A wants acknowledgement of a specific clue A actually found.
comparison: Written attribution of proof versus spoken credit during public tour.
seedUse: D129 receipt/report/found versus attended; S05 training evidence attribution.
